authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant

facts.title: corrective action following root cause analysis at PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant on PSV-8201 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during routine operation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 27 April 2012 a corrective action on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
